welcome.title: Welcome back, Rosa! 🌹
welcome.body: Your recipes, your labels, your brand — all in one place. Everything stays right here on this computer.
welcome.gettingStartedBody: Rosa, here's your three-step process for every new glycerin soap label.

onboarding.title: Let's make your first label, Rosa!
onboarding.subtitle: Four simple steps — everything is visual and stays right here on this computer.
